reason: Adds parent account and quota dimension metadata so Spark shadow accounts can share parent account routing while remaining distinguishable from global accounts.
risk: The migration adds a NOT NULL column with a default, adds table constraints, and validates those constraints on accounts, which can briefly take locks while PostgreSQL validates existing rows.
mitigation: The change is additive and idempotent, defaults existing accounts to the current global dimension, and creates constraints as NOT VALID before explicit validation. Run during the normal dev deploy window and keep the existing deploy health checks in place.
